title: FOCIL in Lighthouse
description: FOCIL puts censorship resistance directly into consensus: each slot, a 16-validator committee broadcasts inclusion lists, and fork choice refuses to extend payloads that ignore them. We've been working on implementing EIP-7805 in Lighthouse (as EPF fellows), and this talk will detail how we've done it and what we learned throughout the process.
abstract: A walkthrough FOCIL(EIP-7805) implementation in Lighthouse, done as part of the Ethereum Protocol Fellowship. A dive into how inclusion lists are produced, gossiped, stored, and enforced in Lighthouse, and what we learned from taking this initiative from a moving spec to a working implementation.
